ideas.name: with the 20-session average: long above, short below
ideas.why: the daily trend's holders add on intraday breakouts its way and fade those against it

ideas.name: yesterday closed strong its way (top / bottom fifth)
ideas.why: a close at the extreme carries overnight and next-day continuation from late buyers (sellers)

ideas.name: at a new session high (long) / low (short)
ideas.why: a breakout to a new day extreme has no one trapped above (below) to sell (buy) into it

ideas.name: through a round 100 in the last 10 minutes
ideas.why: round numbers hold resting stops and options strikes; crossing one triggers them

ideas.name: the first two hours or the last two (not 10:30-13:00)
ideas.why: breakouts need participation: the open and the afternoon hold most of it

ideas.name: the day's range already 1 ADR or more
ideas.why: a wide day is a trending day; its breakouts continue (the late-size rule assumes the opposite)

ideas.name: price on the trade's side of the RTH open
ideas.why: the day's open is its reference; a breakout on the winning side has the day's flow with it

ideas.name: VXN at 25 or above
ideas.why: in calm markets dealers are long gamma and pin; breakouts fail. Above 25 they run
